newsitem.title: LATVIA: MINISTER APPROVES PRIVATISATION AGENCY BOARD.
newsitem.headline: MINISTER APPROVES PRIVATISATION AGENCY BOARD.

text.p: Economy Minister Guntar Krasts has approved the line-up of the privatisation agency's board, including the technical manager and privatisation process manager who kept their jobs after a competition.
Krasts approval leaves the board unchanged for another three year period, the LPA said in a statement.
Technical manager Arvis Freibergs and privatisation process manager Andrejs Tiknuss had to face a competition for their jobs after Krasts in March rejected them.
Krasts had wanted the board changed as he said the privatisation process was taking too long.
Janis Naglis stays as head of the agency, legal director is Viktor Shadinov and the finance manager is Ilmar Razumovskis.
